levels.label: flat record
levels.desc: a single object, every field present

levels.label: nested groups

challenges.desc: numbers/booleans written as text → emit a real number/boolean
normalise category text to its canonical form ("Med"→"medium")
keep only the first N items; drop the extras
wrap the whole result under one top-level key
preserve special characters, escaped correctly for the target
